description: This file defines the 'Create' class in the GuzzleHttpomise namespace, providing static methods to generate and handle promises, including creating fulfilled, rejected, and pending promises, as well as converting values to promises or iterators.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate and work with promises within the GuzzleHttpomise namespace.

methods.name: promiseFor
methods.description: Creates a promise for a value if the value is not already a promise.

methods.name: rejectionFor
methods.description: Creates a rejected promise for a reason if not already a promise.

methods.name: exceptionFor
methods.description: Creates an exception for a rejected promise value.

methods.name: iterFor
methods.description: Returns an iterator for the given value.
